This is a soft-sided textile case with an outer surface coated with silicone, similar to a briefcase. That points to heading 4202, which covers trunks, suitcases, briefcases, document cases and similar containers.

Within 4202.92 (outer surface of sheeting of plastics or textile materials), the textile-surface options are:
- 4202.92.04 – Briefcases, school bags and similar with outer surface of textile materials (older classification)
- 4202.92.9026 and similar – other containers of textile materials
- 4202.92.31 – Other: travel, sports and similar bags with outer surface of textile materials

Coated textile fabric with silicone is probably a "fabric with plastics" case. Silicone is a plastic in the Chapter 39 sense, and the outer surface is a coated textile, so the likely classification is 4202.92.

For a briefcase-like case, the more specific subheading 4202.12 covers trunks, suitcases, vanity cases, executive cases, briefcases, school satchels and similar containers. Under it, 4202.12.81 covers those with an outer surface of plastics or textile materials, with 4202.12.8130 for other items of textile materials. An item "akin to a briefcase" fits 4202.12 (briefcases) with outer surface of textile materials, which is 4202.12.8130 or 4202.12.8110 (the latter probably being "with outer surface of plastic sheeting").

Under 4202.12.81, the options are:
- 4202.12.81 – Other
- 4202.12.8130 – Other (Of man-made fibers?) 

I'll go with 4202.12.8130 as the best fit.
